sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, p.birthday, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_present FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97 AND CAST(SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015 ORDER BY p.player_name
